description.zh: 是否全部删除，只针对tags为空时有效。取值范围： true  false True False   默认是 false
description.en: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources. This parameter takes effect only if you do not specify \`tagKey\`. Valid values: \`true\` and \`false\`. Default value: \`false\`.
The IDs of the resources. You can specify a maximum of 50 resource IDs.

description.zh: 对应标签键列表，最多包含20个子项
description.en: A list of tag keys. You can specify a maximum of 20 tag keys.
